Backtest me 30R, kharche ke baad sirf 10R? 💸

200 trades, har trade +0.15R = 30R. Har trade ka kharcha (spread, commission, slippage) 0.1R ho, to 20R kharche me gaya. Bina kharche ka backtest adhoora hai.
